description: This file defines various interfaces for system management, discovery, configuration, lifetime, and metadata within the WPEFramework's plugin controller component. It mainly consists of interface class declarations with pure virtual functions, annotations, and some structures.

classes.name: ISystemManagement
classes.description: Interface for system management operations like reboot, delete, clone plugin, and environment variable retrieval.

classes.name: IDiscovery
classes.description: Interface for network discovery operations, including starting discovery and retrieving results.

classes.name: IConfiguration
classes.description: Interface for configuration persistence and retrieval.

classes.name: ILifeTime
classes.description: Interface for managing plugin lifecycle states and notifications.

classes.name: ILifeTime::INotification
classes.description: Notification interface for plugin state changes.

classes.name: IMetadata
classes.description: Interface for retrieving metadata details like proxies, status, process info, and version.

methods.name: Reboot
methods.description: Reboots the device.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Removes contents of a directory from persistent storage.

methods.name: Clone
methods.description: Creates a clone of a plugin with a new callsign.

methods.name: Environment
methods.description: Provides the value of a request environment variable.

methods.name: StartDiscovery
methods.description: Starts network discovery process with a specified TTL value.

methods.name: DiscoveryResults
methods.description: Provides the results of network discovery.

methods.name: Persist
methods.description: Stores configuration to persistent memory.

methods.name: Configuration
methods.description: Retrieves or sets configuration value for a plugin.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a plugin for lifecycle notifications.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Unregisters a plugin from lifecycle notifications.

methods.name: Activate
methods.description: Activates a plugin.

methods.name: Deactivate
methods.description: Deactivates a plugin.

methods.name: Unavailable
methods.description: Marks a plugin as unavailable for interaction.

methods.name: Hibernate
methods.description: Sets a plugin to Hibernate state with a timeout.

methods.name: Suspend
methods.description: Suspends a plugin.

methods.name: Resume
methods.description: Resumes a suspended plugin.

methods.name: Proxies
methods.description: Provides details of currently running proxies.

methods.name: Status
methods.description: Provides status of a plugin.

methods.name: Links
methods.description: Provides active connection details.

methods.name: ProcessInfo
methods.description: Provides framework process information.

methods.name: Subsystems
methods.description: Provides details about active subsystems.

methods.name: Version
methods.description: Provides version information of WPEFramework.

methods.name: CallStack
methods.description: Provides callstack information for a given thread index.
